privacyBanner: Use a private browsing window for sensitive conversations. Closing this notice does not change how data is stored.
title: Private words. Ordinary emoji.
subtitle: Encrypt locally, then talk directly or carry the ciphertext through any channel you already trust.
ipDisclosure: P2P reveals your IP address to the other person. Google's STUN server sees both IP addresses while connecting. It never carries message content.
fallbackDetail: Carry each encrypted emoji message through another channel.
p2pDetail: Encrypted messages travel over the open data channel.
startHelp: Create an offer, send it once, then paste the answer.
reloadNotice: Reloading destroys conversation keys and message history. Start a fresh handshake to continue.
joinHelp: Paste the offer you received and return the generated answer.
lateWarning: Late or out-of-order messages may not open. Old keys are intentionally destroyed.
emptyConversation: No messages yet. Verify the safety number before speaking.
manualHelp: Agree on a strong passphrase through a separate trusted channel. Every output is self-contained.
otpWarning: The key must be truly random, large enough for both directional regions, and no byte may ever be reused.
keyGenerated: A random key was generated and downloaded. Share it only through a secure offline channel.
otpRoleA: Role A (uses the first send region)
otpRoleB: Role B (uses the second send region)
otpCapacityWarning: A direct handshake selects this role from public-key order. Otherwise agree who is A and B before use. Authentication reserves 64 bytes and each direction receives half of the remaining key file.
footer: No account. No message server. No silent failures.
clearWarning: This permanently removes contacts, ratchet positions, preferences, and one-time pad offsets from local storage.
clearConfirm: I understand that saved state cannot be recovered.
openFailed: Could not open the message: wrong key or damaged data.
verifySafety: Read this number to the other person through a trusted channel. A mismatch can mean interception.
offerReady: Offer ready. Send it through another channel.
answerReady: Answer ready. Return it to the person who started.
reconnectReady: Reconnect offer ready. Send it and complete the new SDP exchange.
otpKeyRequired: Load the same random key file first.
landingSubtitle: Private conversation without an account, a message database, or a hidden relay. Encrypt here, then connect directly or carry emoji ciphertext yourself.
noInstall: No install. No account. Session keys stay in memory.
localEncryptionText: Web Crypto performs encryption in this tab. Plaintext is not sent to an application server.
ephemeralText: Reloading destroys live conversation keys and visible message history.
noServerText: Direct chat uses a peer data channel. Manual mode lets you choose the transport.
explicitFailureText: Damaged data, wrong keys, and unverified peers stop the flow instead of failing silently.
stepExchangeText: Move the offer and answer through a channel you already have.
stepVerifyText: Read the same eight characters through a separate trusted channel.
stepChatText: Use P2P when appropriate, or carry authenticated emoji ciphertext yourself.
limitsIntro: This experimental tool reduces stored data. It does not solve every threat.
ipVisibleText: Direct WebRTC reveals peer IP addresses and contacts Google's STUN service while connecting.
noAuditText: Do not substitute this project for a mature audited messenger in high-risk situations.
deviceRiskText: Malware, screenshots, copied text, and an unlocked screen remain outside this app's control.
closingTitle: Start with a code, not an account.
verifyBeforeWriting: Verify the safety number to write
verifyPeerHelp: Compare this number over a separate trusted channel. Sending stays locked until you confirm.
directChannelError: The direct data channel reported an error.
rootKeyMissing: A shared root key has not been established.
reconnectSessionRequired: A live in-memory P2P session is required for this reconnect offer. Continue with manual emoji instead.
conversationMissing: There is no conversation state to reconnect.
verificationRequired: Verify the safety number before sending.
incomingRequired: Paste an incoming emoji message first.
strengthStrong: Passphrase meets the local strength check
strengthWeak: Passphrase does not meet the local strength check
otpDirectionInvalid: OTP message direction does not match the receive role.
chooseConnection: How do you want to connect?
chooseConnectionHelp: Choose the side you are taking.
sendOfferHelp: Send this offer once, then paste the answer here.
responseReadyHelp: Send this code back to the person who started, then wait for the connection.
verificationTooFast: You are verifying quickly. Recheck over the separate channel before continuing.
rememberSessionHelp: Off by default. Store only an encrypted current ratchet state if you enable this.
pinMethodHelp: Enter the PIN again after reload.
browserMethod: Let this browser hold the key
browserMethodHelp: No PIN, but a script running in this page can still use it.
sessionOffNote: Nothing is stored while this is off.
weakPinWarning: This PIN is easy to guess. A longer random PIN is safer.
pinMismatch: Use at least 6 digits and enter the same PIN twice.
sessionSaved: Session persistence is enabled for this browser.
sessionSaveFailed: Could not save the encrypted session state.
browserPersistenceUnavailable: This browser could not create protected session storage. Persistence remains off.
restoreHelp: Enter the session PIN to restore the latest ratchet position. Message history is not stored.
restoreFailed: PIN incorrect or stored data is damaged.
pinAttemptsExceeded: Too many failed attempts. The saved session was deleted; start a new handshake.
profileHelp: Set this once. It is only a local display label, not an account or global username.
senderWantsToChat: {name} wants to chat with you on anonymous-chat.
youWillConnectTo: You are about to connect with {name}.
verificationDelay: Wait 8 seconds before entering the cross-check code.
verificationReady: Read your safety number through a separate trusted channel, then enter the code they give you.
verificationMismatch: That code does not match. Do not continue until you have checked through a separate channel.
verificationDanger: Safety verification failed. Restart the handshake through a different trusted channel.
confirmPeerThenContinue: Confirm the displayed peer name, then press Finish connection again.
shareLinkWarning: This link contains public handshake data. Anyone with it can try to use it; only send it to the intended person.
turnHelp: Leave empty to use Google STUN only. A TURN server is user-provided and never bundled.
turnInvalid: Use a TURN URL beginning with turn: or turns:.
autoLockHelp: Hide the workspace after inactivity. This protects against casual viewing, not a running compromised script.
lockPinInvalid: Use at least 6 digits and enter the same PIN twice.
lockedHelp: This is a local viewing barrier. It does not erase or re-key the active session.
ratchetDriftHelp: Set up a new secure handshake. Visible history stays on screen but old messages may not open again.
checksumFailed: The message was damaged during transfer. Send it again through another channel.
backupHelp: The file contains encrypted current ratchet state and contact metadata only. It is not live sync.
backupRequiresSession: Create or restore a conversation before exporting a backup.
cameraUnavailable: Camera scanning is unavailable. Paste the offer code or use a link instead.
heartbeatTimeout: The direct channel stopped responding. Use manual transfer or create a reconnect offer.
weakOverrideHelp: This passphrase is below the recommended threshold. Type the sentence below to continue knowingly.
weakOverridePhrase: I understand this passphrase may be guessed.
reloadSetupWarning: Reloading this page during setup clears your keys and history. Finish the handshake in one sitting.
manualTransportStatus: Manual mode: you copy and send each result yourself. There is no read receipt or delivery confirmation.
